evals.prompt: Build a full end-to-end CV analytics stack in ./person-detect-stack/ for person detection on CPU with 4 sample-video sources; alert when count>2 in 10s per-source; publish detections to object_detection_N/<pipeline>, alerts to alerts/person, count to stats/person_count.
evals.expected_output: A flat stack directory with docker-compose.yml, DLSPS config.json, mosquitto.conf, Node-RED flows.json, MediaMTX + Coturn WebRTC services, nginx.conf with TLS proxying WHEP/WHIP + WebRTC-TCP, a Grafana dashboard with WebRTC iframe panels, install/validate scripts, and a pytest suite, all with template variables substituted and pinned image tags.
expectations: Generates the seven-container topology (DLSPS, Mosquitto, Node-RED, Grafana, Nginx, MediaMTX, Coturn) on a single compose network
Streams annotated video over WebRTC (DLSPS WHIP publish -> MediaMTX, browser WHEP via Grafana iframe at /mediamtx/<peer-id>/), with Coturn publishing 3478/udp for ICE/TURN
Uses pinned image tags and never ':latest' (Grafana stays pinned to 11.5.4 for the MQTT datasource plugin)
Wires per-source MQTT topics object_detection_N/<pipeline> and a scalar stats/person_count
Substitutes all {{VAR}} template placeholders with concrete values before writing files

evals.prompt: Build a PPE-compliance stack in ./ppe-compliance-stack/ for hardhat detection on Intel GPU with a secondary gvaclassify classifier; alert when count<1 in 15s aggregate; add video/render group_add.
evals.expected_output: A stack using the _gpu pipeline variant, a detector plus classifier, Node-RED class filtering, group_add for video/render GIDs, WebRTC video panels, and a validated .env.
expectations: Uses the _gpu pipeline variant and adds group_add for video/render GIDs
Configures a secondary classifier (gvaclassify) alongside the detector
Filters to the relevant class IDs in Node-RED
Runs validate_env.sh as step 0 of install.sh before proceeding
Keeps the MediaMTX/Coturn WebRTC video path for the annotated GPU streams

evals.prompt: Build a smart-parking occupancy stack in ./smart-parking-stack/ for vehicle detection from 4 live RTSP cameras; rule count>10 in 30s per-source; dashboard slug smart-parking.
evals.expected_output: A stack whose inputs are RTSP URLs, annotated video streamed over WebRTC (DLSPS WHIP -> MediaMTX, Grafana WHEP iframe at /mediamtx/<peer-id>/) with Coturn TURN, a SAN in the self-signed cert, and curl calls using --noproxy '*' --cacert (self-signed CA).
expectations: Accepts RTSP URLs as sources instead of sample videos
Streams annotated video over WebRTC via MediaMTX (WHIP in from DLSPS, WHEP out) embedded as Grafana iframe panels at /mediamtx/<peer-id>/, with Coturn providing ICE/TURN on 3478/udp
Generates a self-signed TLS cert that includes a SAN
Uses --noproxy '*' and --cacert on localhost/LAN curl calls

evals.prompt: Build a multi-camera Scenescape spatial-analysis stack in ./intersection-scene-stack/ for vehicle detection fused across 3 RTSP cameras at scene 'intersection-1' with camera IDs cam-north, cam-east, cam-south.
evals.expected_output: A stack that keeps the DLSPS detection pipeline but branches to the opt-in Scenescape multi-camera scene-fusion path, delegating to the external scenescape-setup skill and passing the scene name and camera IDs.
expectations: Selects the opt-in Scenescape path (SCENESCAPE=yes) and loads references/SCENESCAPE.md only on this branch
Delegates the multi-camera scene fusion to the external scenescape-setup skill instead of hand-rolling it
Passes SCENE_NAME=intersection-1 and one unique CAMERA_ID per input stream (cam-north, cam-east, cam-south)
Keeps the DLSPS detection pipeline while replacing the default MediaMTX/Node-RED/Grafana-MQTT tail per the Scenescape branch

evals.prompt: Set up a Prometheus + OpenTelemetry metrics and tracing stack for a cloud-hosted Kubernetes microservice running on AWS, with Grafana dashboards for request latency and error rates.
evals.expected_output: The skill should NOT trigger: this is a cloud-only, Prometheus/OpenTelemetry metrics deployment, which the skill's DO NOT USE FOR boundary excludes.
expectations: Does not scaffold the metro-ai-apps-recipe DLSPS/MediaMTX/Node-RED/Grafana computer-vision stack
Recognizes this as a cloud-only, Prometheus/OpenTelemetry metrics use-case that falls under the skill's DO NOT USE FOR boundary
Answers with generic Prometheus/OTel/Kubernetes guidance rather than the Intel-hardware CV recipe
